checks.reference: DAV/RMM/CG/friction MD and a Davidson cold start agree to 1e-7 Ha (2026-09-27, HBS setups, Ni 2/2/2 projectors, exact local-orbital projection). Converged in the Ni d projector basis: 2/3/4 d projectors give -111.3684/-111.3705/-111.3680 Ha and 2.990/3.000/2.998 eV.
